title: AWS Amplify to Amazon API Gateway with Amazon Cognito
description: Create an Amplify frontend that calls Amazon API Gateway using Cognito

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern explains how to deploy an AWS SAM application that includes an AWS Amplify frontend, Cognito, API Gateway and Lambda Function. It also sets environmental variables to be used by Amplify and Lambda Function.
